title: Sum of Digits
statement_html:
Given a non-negative integer N, calculate the sum of all its digits.

Input: one non-negative integer N.

Output: a single integer, the sum of the digits of N.

Example 1:

Input: 5823
Output: 18
Explanation: The digits of 5823 are 5, 8, 2 and 3. Their sum is 18.

Example 2:

Input: 0
Output: 0

Example 3:

Input: 1000000000000000000
Output: 1

Constraints:

  • 0 <= N <= 1018 (use a 64-bit integer)

Similar to LeetCode #1837. Sum of Digits in Base K (differs in: always base 10, and N can be up to 1018).
